technical.summary: Strong bullish structure with multiple moving average confirmations and breakout signals, but extreme overbought conditions across RSI, Stochastic, and Williams %R create elevated pullback risk; best suited for profit-taking or tight-stop entries rather than aggressive swing initiation.

fundamental.summary: FE shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 15 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; fear sentiment (37/100) presents mild contrarian opportunity, but absence of recent news data and stale congressional trades (617+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (390) combined with flat yield curve and imminent earnings (15 days) creates severely adverse macro conditions for FE trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical structure with three white soldiers, price above all major moving averages, and new 20-day highs provides bullish directional confirmation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions across RSI, Stochastic, and Williams %R combined with crisis-level VIX (390), imminent earnings (15 days), unfavorable macro, and zero fundamental/smart money support create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.
